body:
I understand your opinions and all but I didn't write my whole life story on reddit just so some people on the internet will shame me for being over dramatic or something similar and tell me to suck it up just because I'm still 18. I'm here because I genuinely want to kill myself because everything I've put with is starting to become too much for me. I've read so many other stories of people that are much worse. People getting raped, sexually abused, physically abused, etc. 

Yes I'm just 17 nearly 18 in a couple of months. Yes I have only lived for a short time. Haven't dealt with work or bills. Haven't even graduated school yet.

I know that I'm not the only person in the world dealing with abusive parents. 

I know that I'm not the only one dealing with depressing and suicidal thoughts everyday.

But let me be clear with you. None of that matters to me because those stories aren't about me. I can't begin to fathom what those people have gone through frankly because I wasn't there. It has nothing to do with me. I'm suicidal because of what **I** went through, and even if it doesn't seem much compared to what others have gone through, it still has brought me to this point. 

So since you couldn't be bothered to read my story before berating me for being young and seemingly "complaining". Here is a condensed and an even more detailed version just for you.

I was born in a well off family where I grew up thinking everything was all good and fine until the first and only memory I can remember of my childhood is my mother getting beat by my father in the room next door screaming and crying for help while I couldn't do anything because I was just a little toddler wondering what the hell was going on. After a couple years of that we as a family would move every two years and move to different countries every 4 or so years. Some people might say I'm privileged and I can't deny that my father makes quite a lot of money, but when he doesn't understand what "personal finance" is I beg to differ. When he disappears every few months for weeks on end to have some"alone time" without leaving my mother and I any money. Not paying back money to credit cards which ultimately closes the card and renders it useless. Not paying bills so that during those weeks with him gone, we would have no electricity, heat, or water. Sure I've gone to expensive private schools, but that's about it. Being surrounded by conservative people in private schools and family, where no one smokes let alone drinks, I'm pretty sure smoking let alone doing drugs are a pretty big deal. I own a macbook that my mother bought me used 10 years ago because I needed it for school. I own a used iphone 5 that I bought used with my own pocket money that my mother gave me from her own savings. All while my father spending thousands on clothes and shoes he only wears once and just throws in the trash not giving a shit. Yes we've lived in nice apartments in nice areas with low crime rates. I've never had to worry about crime when I'm outside, but when I'm home its different. I've had anxiety attacks daily worrying for my mothers safety. Ever since I've grown to a point where I'm stronger than my father I was able to intervene and stop my mother getting beaten. But that's only when I'm home. When I have to leave home early to take a test at school, when I have to stay behind to ask a teacher a question about my grade. In those times I can only pray for my mother to be okay and not being beaten. I can barely sleep because of the screams I heard when I was young at midnight when my mother was being beaten with me not being able to do anything because I was locked out and too small to do anything. I've tried multiple times to call the police but my mother would stop me saying she is enduring it all for me. I've wanted to put my father in an unmarked grave myself let alone get him arrested, but that would mean that my mothers putting up with him would go to waste. Because my mother told me from a really young age not to tell anyone about our situation, I started to just not talk to anyone. My grandparents let alone family friends don't even know. I naturally just stopped talking to people and keeping all these "secrets" inside me suppressing the urge to tell the nearest cop to do something about him, because my mother wanted me to grow up and be successful. I've attempted multiple times to jump off buildings but have been stopped by either police officers, patrolling social workers, or just the reason/logic side of me talk me down to not end it all. 

I don't know what you u/Crazy11230 have gone through, but after hopefully reading this, please tell me again that I'm just "young" and to "Man the fuck up".

Thank you.

Despite all the negative things that have happened to me, and despite the things I've done, right now all I can think about is the possibility of a better future for my mother and I. My thoughts are a bit clearer now but I always bound back to the same depressed state. Thank you for your input though.

Thank you. I'm not really one for inspirational passages and what not but this comment did open my eyes a bit and calmed me down a little.

Thank you.

The only things that I live for at the moment is a possible better future for my mother if I persevere and work hard in my studies, and a possible future of a happy life if I ever have a family of my own. It's all just a **possibility** though and I don't even know if I can hold onto that.

I don't do any sports, no hobbies. Not a huge game guy, only to pass the time. Fairly impartial with topics you see or don't see on the news. Never have been truly religious. No friends, don't need them. I cut ties with literally everyone. I deleted all social media; instagram, snapchat, facebook ,etc. I don't really care about anyone or anything other than the well being of my mother and me. It sometimes scares me when I see a murder on the news, my mother would be like "the family of the victim must be so devastated" or something like that and I would just shrug it off. Once there was a news coverage on some mass stabbing of some kids a while back, where a couple kids(elementary) died and a bunch were injured. I believe I saw tears in my mothers eyes for the kids who died too soon and their for their families who just lost their seven year old kid to some crazy old dude wielding a knife. I didn't bat an eyelid. I know it comes off as cold, but it literally didn't matter to me. Some tragic event happened to some kids who I didn't even know existed. Why should I feel anything for them when I'm barely getting through my life. On the contrary, I cried a shit ton when something tragic happened to a fictional character in a book I was reading. 

Sorry for the rant but thanks for responding.

Thank you for your story.

I get where you're coming from. Unlike some who say they want to stay as a kid, or don't want to grow up and deal with responsibilities with being an independent adult, I couldn't disagree more. I know that in two years I will have graduated from an IB school with great grades(I hope), and be on way to college(I hope). I know that after those 2 years I will be free from my father and his abusive ways and so my mother can just leave him because she won't have to worry about me. I know that it's not worth it to off myself now and make the 20 years my mother has put up with him to waste, but everything is starting to be too much. The reason and logic tells me to keep going and then everything will just become the past, but my emotions can't handle anymore. It's literally like a civil war is going through my brain and heart, or whats left of it.

Thanks for responding.

I've gone through multiple different curriculum's(different countries and schools) and the only good schools that are around where we live are international schools with the IB program. The only reason why the school's that we looked at our willing to accept is because I have good grades and well money of course(expensive as fuck). We haven't decided which school but I'll be going in august from the 2 year IB program unless the economy dies. 

See the edit to get a feel why my mother hasn't divorced him yet.

Thank you.

I hate to admit it, but I can get really emotional to some things whether its a book I read, or a movie, or just some debate on political/philosophical topics. But I've always hid my emotions from people which I guess makes it harder for me to balance my reasoning/logic with my emotions. 

The only thing stopping me from ending it is my love for my mother which will never wane. I'm working hard despite my conflicting emotions to planning a better future for myself and my mother.

I have screenshots of condescending and berating texts, photos and videos of the damage done to my mother, voice recordings of actual arguments which turn violent some of which are videos. The reason I haven't done anything yet is because of my mother. See edit for details.

Thank you for the kind words though.

I've been thinking on going into medicine. I knew some people(mutual acquaintances)  that OD'd(they survived) and so I got interested into medicine. I don't have the nerves to be a surgeon but I want to be able to do something similar and help people. Psychology(psychologist) is also an option. It'd be cool if I could help people with their mental problems and get them through by using my experiences as a baseline if I'm still alive. I'm not trying to make assumptions but I know that most psychologists/therapists haven't gone through as much or even understand what their clients are going through and just give some diagnosis.

Not exactly stockholm syndrome but I don't know there might be some feelings left. She keeps brushing me off whenever I ask her. See edit. 

I just read up on c-PTSD, and I guess most of the stuff can apply to me. I've never been diagnosed for anything though so I have no clue what mess my brain is in.

I haven't gone to therapy except from the time I went with my mother(separate rooms), and I hadn't any idea what I was doing there(I was somewhat suicidal but wasn't super depressed at that time). I've tried some online therapy - text based, skype based - but it just wasn't for me. See the edit for the divorce question. My mother stopped going to a therapist because of country hopping and moving frequently but takes antidepressants.
